metrics.name: Sponsor Engagement Index
metrics.description: Qualitative assessment of sponsor visibility: communications sent, program events attended, floor walks.
metrics.how_measured: Change-team observation log scored per reporting period
metrics.threshold_red: Executive sponsor inactive for a full cycle

metrics.name: Change Network Activation Rate
metrics.description: Share of designated change-agent positions that are filled and actively participating.

metrics.name: Pulse Survey Response Rate
metrics.description: Share of targeted stakeholders completing each pulse survey wave — a health check on the measurement channel itself.
metrics.how_measured: Completed responses / targeted population per wave

metrics.name: Stakeholder Readiness Score
metrics.description: Average score across the anchor pulse questions; tracked by BU and wave-over-wave.
metrics.how_measured: Mean of anchor question scores (1–5) per segment
metrics.notes: Baseline established at first pulse — deliberately blank until then.

metrics.name: Training Completion Rate
metrics.description: Share of targeted users who completed required role-based training. (Deeper training-effectiveness evaluation lives in the training workstream.)
metrics.how_measured: Completions / targeted users per role and BU

metrics.name: Change Impact Mitigation Coverage
metrics.description: Share of documented high-severity change impacts with a completed mitigation plan.
metrics.how_measured: Mitigated high-severity impacts / total high-severity impacts in the CIA

metrics.name: System Login Rate
metrics.description: Share of expected users who have logged into the new system within 7/14/30 days of go-live.
metrics.how_measured: Distinct logins / expected user population at Day 7, 14, 30

metrics.name: Transaction Completion Rate
metrics.description: Share of core business transactions processed through the new system versus legacy workarounds.
metrics.how_measured: New-system transaction volume / total transaction volume

metrics.name: Replenishment Exception-Handling Compliance
metrics.description: Share of replenishment exceptions triaged through the designed exception workflow rather than manual overrides.
metrics.how_measured: Exceptions handled per designed workflow / total exceptions (audit sample)
metrics.source: Process audit / spot checks; system override logs
linked_impacts: Automated replenishment replacing manual reorder spreadsheets

metrics.name: Workaround Incidence Rate
metrics.description: Reported instances of users bypassing the new system or process.
metrics.how_measured: Count of reported workarounds per period, by BU
metrics.target: Declining trend; zero by end of hypercare

metrics.name: Support Ticket Volume & Trend
metrics.description: Volume and trend of adoption-attributable support tickets post-go-live.
metrics.how_measured: Weekly ticket count in adoption-related categories; week-over-week trend

metrics.name: Replenishment Cycle Time
metrics.description: End-to-end time from demand signal to purchase order release.
metrics.how_measured: Median cycle time from operational reporting
metrics.notes: Baseline and target deliberately blank — to be measured pre-go-live and set by the process owner, not invented.

metrics.name: Inventory Turns
metrics.description: Working-capital efficiency of inventory; the business-case lever behind replenishment automation.
metrics.how_measured: COGS / average inventory, per Finance definition
metrics.notes: Owned by Finance; included for alignment. Target per business case — blank until confirmed.

measurement_plan.reporting_cadence: Weekly change-team review during hypercare; monthly steering committee dashboard.
measurement_plan.review_forum: Steering committee (monthly) for the activation set; change-team weekly for the full register.
measurement_plan.escalation: Any red metric is escalated to the program sponsor at the next steering committee, with owner-prepared cause analysis and intervention proposal.
measurement_plan.baseline_approach: Perception baselines from the first pulse survey; process/value baselines measured from operational and finance reporting before go-live. No targets set before a baseline exists.
measurement_plan.data_collection_notes: Confirm with the platform team which usage telemetry is instrumentable before go-live; service-desk categories need an adoption tag added.
